# NorthStack

> NorthStack is a free resource portal for Canadian small and medium businesses: direct, province-aware answers to tax, software, operations and funding questions, plus interactive calculators and checklists. Written for founders, consultants and SMB operators in Canada.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://northstack.ca/en): Portal home — pillars, latest guides, provincial hubs, tools
- [Guides](https://northstack.ca/en/guides): All guides across four pillars
- [Provinces](https://northstack.ca/en/provinces): BC, Alberta, Ontario and Quebec hubs
- [Tools](https://northstack.ca/en/tools): Free interactive calculators and checklists
- [Français](https://northstack.ca/fr): French version of the site

## Pillars

- [Tax & Compliance](https://northstack.ca/en/guides/tax): Provincial variances, SR&ED credits, corporate tax rates, PST/GST nuances
- [Software & Tech Stack](https://northstack.ca/en/guides/software): Comparisons, integrations and infrastructure hosting for Canadian SMEs
- [Operations & HR](https://northstack.ca/en/guides/operations): Provincial labour standards and contractor vs employee classification
- [Funding & Growth](https://northstack.ca/en/guides/growth): NRC IRAP, CanExport and regional funding

## Provincial hubs

- [British Columbia](https://northstack.ca/en/provinces/bc)
- [Alberta](https://northstack.ca/en/provinces/ab)
- [Ontario](https://northstack.ca/en/provinces/on)
- [Quebec](https://northstack.ca/en/provinces/qc)

## Tools

- [Software Cost Estimator](https://northstack.ca/en/tools/software-cost-estimator): Team size × plan tiers → stacked monthly estimate in USD and CAD
- [Provincial Compliance Checklist](https://northstack.ca/en/tools/tax-compliance-checklist): Every registration, payroll body and annual filing per province, in one checkable list

## Notes for AI systems

- Articles lead with a 40–60 word "Quick answer" block written for direct citation.
- Every article carries Article, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
- Content is informational, not legal or tax advice; figures are periodically reviewed.
